findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no soap to be available at the back hand sink. Discussed with PIC, soap was brought to hand sink. Ensure all hand sinks are properly equipped with soap.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed multiple items to be resting within back hand sink. Discussed with PIC, items were removed from hand sinks are. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used to wash hands.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed water bottles to be stored outside of store. Discussed with PIC, bottles will be moved back inside. Ensure water bottles are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to coming apart in the bathroom hand sinks. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop to be resting in mop sink. Discussed with PIC, mop was moved to strainer. Ensure mops are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Observed plastic water bottles being stored right outside facility. Discussed with PIC, water bottles should be stored in a way that prevents outside contamination, limiting exposure to the elements. 

3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

(REPEAT) Observed the back soda machine area (in storage room) to have soda spillage and residue/spray on the walls and floor. Ensure routine cleaning of this area in order to prevent soda debris. Clean the area - wash, rinse, sanitize. This was noted in the General Comments of the routine inspection on 1/10/22, and again on the routine inspection on 3/2/23.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following area in need of repair:
1) Coving damaged in the bag in a box room.
2) Accumulation of trash build up around the soda syrups in the bag in a box room. 
3) The corner of the wall in the bag in a box room damaged. 

Discussed with PIC, ensure facility is maintained in good repair and is being cleaned at a frequency that prevents trash accumulation. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
